labels.rationale: Only c locates the installed version number; b covers shortcuts and a covers appearance.
Only c enables line numbers; a wraps lines and b highlights the cursor row.
Only a gives the twelve-file limit; b covers pinning and c covers path display.
Only c gives the command-palette shortcut; b and a open different navigation tools.
Only c locates the Light and Dark choices; b and a adjust size or spacing.
Only b specifies the refresh interval; c describes status and a describes indexed scope.
Only b lists supported formats; c covers zoom and a covers captions.
Only b sorts by due date; c filters completion status and a adds an owner column.
Only a identifies export completion status; b configures page size and c navigates headings.
Only a supplies the suggested filename; b and c describe other save-related metadata.
Only c toggles the sidebar; b and a toggle other window regions.
Only a explains the hollow circle; c and b explain different tab symbols.
Only b limits writing width; c enlarges controls and a dims text without changing width.
Only a provides a navigable heading hierarchy; b and c organize images or revisions.
Only c compares current and saved content; a and b report counts or file properties.
Only c displays two documents simultaneously; a and b retain a single content pane.
Only a restricts results by the .md extension; b and c change matching case or presentation.
Only a links editor movement to the preview; b and c change preview appearance.
Only b makes export alerts visual and silent; c and a explicitly leave export announcements unchanged.
Only b distinguishes spaces and tabs with visible markers; c and a change width or add a ruler.
Only c exposes the latest failed job's diagnostic cause; b and a discuss badges or notification preferences.
Only b reports the active document's complete location; c and a concern other files or search results.
Only a reports the active file's detected character format; b and c discuss defaults or general definitions.
Only b counts the highlighted range; c changes its color and a estimates whole-document pagination.
